Module io.github.jpersist.tools.api

Package persistence.tools.spi

package persistence.tools.spi
Service Provider Interfaces (SPI) and discovery mechanisms for Persistence Tools.

This package defines the SPI abstractions implemented by persistence providers (e.g. Hibernate ORM 6 for Jakarta Persistence or Hibernate 5 for legacy javax.persistence). Implementations are discovered at runtime via the ServiceLoader API based on the target JPA specification version.

  • PersistenceServiceProvider – root interface for all persistence service providers, providing namespace resolution and version-based lookup.
  • PersistenceLinterFactory – base factory contract for discovering persistence linter factories by JPA version.
  • NamedObjectParserFactory – factory SPI for creating NamedObjectParser instances.
  • SchemaValidatorFactory – factory SPI for creating SchemaValidator instances.
  • EnhancerProvider – SPI for creating Enhancer instances.
